headline: Hà Tĩnh approves investment policy for a series of wind power projects worth over 7,800 billion VND
summary: Hà Tĩnh province has approved investment policy for four wind power projects in Kỳ Văn, Kỳ Lạc, Kỳ Hoa and Kỳ Thượng, with total capacity of 225MW. The projects are expected to supply about 591,456 million kWh per year to the national grid.
why: Wind power is a growing part of Vietnam's electricity supply, and large renewable projects shape power demand, grid investment and energy-sector capital spending.
